objective: Run the tests of a Python project without a manifest: init detects its .py files, and the extension no longer says "set up first" to a project that is set up.
summary: init now detects a Python project without a manifest from its .py files at the root (pytest runner, no SDK), with a unit test; the extension treats a set-up project (init.json) without tests.json as having no test command instead of asking to set it up, with a unit test. Checked end to end: one test measured as R-1; no test gives pytest's "no tests ran". Not released: the user's installed 0.1.0 still has the bug; not committed.
